g.text: Telegram Migration Pipeline — Ingestion & Fault-Tolerant Checkpoint Flow
Lifecycle Flow • Adaptive FloodWait Backoff • SHA-256 Route Checkpointing • Automatic Crash Resumption
• Load user auth key from session
• Offline parser inspects channel message bodies and MTProto MessageEntityTextUrl hyperlinks without mutating channel state.
• Cleanses URLs, extracts @channel and @user handles, classifies target domains, and computes link frequency distributions.
• Serializes structured findings into streaming JSON, RFC 4180 standard CSV, or OpenPyXL formatted Excel spreadsheets.
Gracefully falls back to CSV if openpyxl is not installed in the host environment
UNEXPECTED CRASH & NETWORK FAILURE RECOVERY GUARANTEES
• Checkpoints were saved after each batch.
• Caught by exception handler; extracts sec.
• If a disk JSON file is truncated or invalid,
and falls back safely without crashing.
